messages.subject: Double scrollbar problem in mobile
parts:
Hi. I made this Shiny app (https://vonlettow.shinyapps.io/Fulbito).

It has 3 columns in the second row. When I look at it in a mobile phone it doesn´t scroll down so I can see all the columns.

If I try it in a browser, adjusting the width of the window I see it generates 2 scrollbars. The one in the original windows and one that seems to appear as a result of the responsive layout.

The one in the original window seems to rule over the other in the phone browser so I can´t scroll down the whole app.

Any solution for this?

Thanks!!!!!!!
